This is an authored project dependency snapshot, not a cache of mutable GitHub
state. Issue URLs and numbers are stable identifiers; GitHub remains the source
for current titles, status, labels, assignees, milestones, and discussion.

The inference and artifact-custody workstreams converge at the portfolio freeze.
E5 registration independently freezes its leakage and interpretation boundary.
Both paths precede the organizer-controlled hidden-test release.

## The branch-complete queue

These are stable work contracts, not copies of mutable issue status. A branch
is complete only when its decision rule can be evaluated from durable evidence.

### [#39 — Build qrel-free unseen-query inference](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_mlm_2026/issues/39)

- **Depends on:** nothing in this queue; it can proceed alongside #40.
- **Outcome:** one command accepts unseen requests, uses no request-specific
  qrels, produces valid TREC rankings, and leaves a reproducible receipt.
- **Smallest valid work item:** a synthetic end-to-end request through input
  validation, frozen feature loading, ranking, and submission validation.
- **Controls and safeguards:** deny qrel-bearing inputs; freeze configuration;
  validate candidate coverage, rank uniqueness, determinism, and TREC format.
- **Decision / stop rule:** pass only when two clean replays are byte-identical
  and the leakage and format checks pass. Stop portfolio work if the path needs
  development-only state unavailable at test time.
- **Positive-result boundary:** this proves executability and integrity, not
  hidden-test effectiveness.
- **Blocker:** the production input/release contract must be known well enough
  to validate the adapter.

### [#40 — Restore durable private artifact custody](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_mlm_2026/issues/40)

- **Depends on:** nothing in this queue; it can proceed alongside #39.
- **Outcome:** every decision-critical profile artifact has a durable private
  object, checksum, provenance receipt, and tested restore path.
- **Smallest valid work item:** restore and verify one representative profile
  bundle from private custody without consulting an ephemeral run directory.
- **Controls and safeguards:** private-only storage, SHA-256 verification,
  least-privilege paths, no raw response publication, and restore rehearsal.
- **Decision / stop rule:** pass only when every portfolio-critical artifact is
  complete and independently restorable. Stop if a required object has only a
  receipt or report snapshot.
- **Positive-result boundary:** custody proves reproducibility, not ranking
  quality.
- **Blocker:** any decision-critical artifact that remains incomplete must be
  restored or explicitly excluded from the frozen portfolio. The generated
  current-state custody view owns the live ledger-derived count.

### [#41 — Freeze the five-run portfolio and release runbook](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_mlm_2026/issues/41)

- **Depends on:** #39 and #40.
- **Outcome:** five named, reproducible runs and an operator-readable release
  runbook are frozen before organizer release.
- **Smallest valid work item:** a dry run that reconstructs one portfolio entry
  from private custody and emits a validated submission through #39.
- **Controls and safeguards:** immutable system IDs/configuration, checksums,
  role separation between selection and execution, rollback steps, and no
  tuning after release evidence is seen.
- **Decision / stop rule:** freeze only when all five entries pass the same dry
  run and every dependency is closed. Reduce the portfolio rather than include
  an unreproducible entry.
- **Positive-result boundary:** readiness to execute five preselected systems;
  not a claim that all five will outperform on hidden data.
- **Blocker:** any unresolved pipeline or custody dependency.

### [#42 — Register E5 raw-response refinement](https://github.com/npatta01/trec_mlm_2026/issues/42)

- **Depends on:** an executable unseen-query path from #39. It does not depend
  on #40 unless its selected artifacts require restoration.
- **Hypothesis:** the frozen 80% broad profile + 20% candidate-local refinement,
  fused equally with the dense ranking, improves the preregistered held-out/test
  metric without unacceptable cohort regressions.
- **Smallest valid panel:** the already specified held-out/test inference scope;
  no additional development search after registration.
- **Controls and safeguards:** dense and promoted controls, frozen variables,
  explicit leakage boundary, fixed metric, and an immutable registration
  receipt created before release evidence.
- **Decision / stop rule:** advance only under the preregistered primary metric
  and cohort guardrail; otherwise retain as informational evidence and stop
  refinement in this form.
- **Positive-result boundary:** evidence for the registered E5 mechanism on the
  named scope, not general proof that raw responses improve routing.
- **Blocker:** E5 is currently completed development follow-up evidence but
  remains off-ledger, unregistered, and unpromoted.
